target_customer: Dental clinics in the US, Australia and the UK
problem: Dental front desks miss calls and spend time on bookings, insurance verification, claims and billing. Patientdesk handles these with AI voice and an AI-native practice management system.
business_model: B2B SaaS for dental clinics (AI receptionist, PMS, marketing tools) with a 14-day trial on the voice agent
product_category: AI front and back office for dental practices

founders.name: Oncel Ozgul
education: University in the Netherlands (unnamed on the YC page), near 4.0 GPA
founders.background_notes: Ranked #1 of 1.2 million on the Turkish national high school exam. Source: YC company page.

founders.name: Emre Kaplaner
education: University of Amsterdam, Data Science and Econometrics

founders.name: Fikri San Koktas
education: Aalto University, BSc Computational Engineering and MSc AI

competitors.name: Weave (TrueLark)
competitors.what: Communications suite with AI receptionist after Weave acquired TrueLark

competitors.name: Zocdoc Zo
competitors.what: AI phone booking priced at $2 per booked appointment

competitors.name: CallDental.AI
competitors.what: Voice receptionist for dental clinics launched in 2025

competitors.name: Arini, Peerlogic, Viva AI
competitors.what: Dental-specific AI voice platforms that book into dental practice software

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents with live insurance verification and integrations with Open Dental, CareStack and others are standard but detailed engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Practice management integrations and moving into PMS create stickiness, but many dental AI receptionists compete.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors already sold AI receptionists to dentists when Patientdesk started; no acquisition of Patientdesk found.

market_need_then: Dental clinics lose revenue to missed calls and manual insurance work. The company says it grew from $17K to $50K MRR in 8 weeks with 60+ live clinics, all self-reported.

identity.voice_and_tone: Revenue focused: fill the calendar with high value appointments.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name plus the .ai suffix; coverage was funding news only, no brand-specific press.

outcome_analysis: Patientdesk.ai is an active Winter 2026 YC company with no exit. It shows fast reported growth (17K to 50K MRR in 8 weeks) and 60+ clinics, and raised a confirmed $1M pre-seed in February 2026 led by Y Combinator with e2vc. Competition from dental-specific AI receptionists is heavy, so execution on integrations will decide the outcome.
notes: The $1M pre-seed (2026-02-23) is confirmed by Webrazzi and a press release (kotaradio). The company website says it announced a $3.8M raise; this is not dated or broken down. One report says a $2.8M seed, which with the $1M would sum to $3.8M, but I found no primary source, so only the $1M is recorded and coverage is partial. A different company, Newton, raised $3.8M with YC participation, so this figure may be confused. Founder education shows school names as given on the YC page.
